highlights: Glass panels: backdrop-filter: blur(5px) on navigation overlay with linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(236,239,241,.8)) background
Browser graphic glassmorphism: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) over rgba(248,250,253,.45) background with 1px border
Navigation menu glassmorphism: backdrop-filter: blur(2.5px) on time-of-day-select menu with rgba(248,250,253,.55) background
Radial gradient orbs for dialog overlays: Four layered radial gradients using --bento-left-blob and --bento-right-blob variables with transforms and filters
Product suite gradient underlines: Animated linear gradients on navigation suite titles with mouse interaction (background-size transition)
Connect card animated border: Radial gradient with mouse position tracking (--card-mouse-x, --card-mouse-y variables) and transform transitions
Stats section ambient gradients: Six time-of-day gradient states (pre-dawn, sunrise, daytime, dusk, sunset, night) that transition between active states
Billing plan usage meter: Linear gradient progress bar with animated translation controlled by --combined-progress variable
Subtle dot pattern on stats globe visualization (visible as decorative overlay)
